add.k: Mike's brother, a Cuban partner of Howard Saint
st: Joe and his brother Mike come to Howard Saint's house over their lost cash, and when a second shipment burns, Howard refuses to pay.

files.notes: Named on screen when Howard greets 'Mike, Joe' and when Mickey calls them 'the Toro brothers'. Subtitles have no speakers, so which brother says which line is unconfirmed; the step stays general. tm uses the name the screen gives their operation ('the Toro brothers'), matching the existing group file pr-toro-brothers; change to Independent if the build only accepts groups_in_app names. Fate after the meeting is not shown.

add.k: A Cuban gangster who launders money through Howard Saint
st: Mike and Joe threaten to drop Howard Saint as their banker, and after a second shipment burns, Howard tells Mike he has more guns.

files.notes: Howard addresses him directly ('And Mike, if you don't like it ... I've got more guns than you do'). tm as for Joe Toro: the screen calls them 'the Toro brothers'; same name as the existing group file. Fate not shown.

add.k: A Puerto Rican local people call a witch doctor
st: At the Castle reunion in Puerto Rico, Frank points out Candelaria, an island loner the locals call a witch doctor.
Candelaria finds Frank left for dead after the massacre, nurses him back to health, and sends him off with 'Vaya con Dios'.

files.notes: Named in dialogue ('is that that Candelaria?' 'Yeah, Manuel.') and he names himself ('It's me, Castle. Candelaria.'). No group named on screen, so Independent. Wikipedia calls him a fisherman; the film only says he lives on an island and is called a witch doctor.

st: Maria welcomes Frank home from his last undercover job and joins him and their son Will at his family's reunion in Puerto Rico.
When Saint's men attack the reunion, Maria flees with Will in a jeep, but John Saint runs them both down on the pier.

files.notes: Name 'Maria' said repeatedly by Frank; surname from Frank Castle. No group named on screen, so Independent. The page says she tells Frank she is pregnant; the transcript has only Frank saying 'We should have another', so that is left out. She also returns as a vision and a voice to Frank; not given a separate step. Also covered by the group file The Castle Family.

add.k: A Turkish mercenary who abducts Dmitri
st: A mercenary with a scar and a Turkish accent is among the four men who break into Dmitri's London apartment and abduct him.
Kraven tracks Ömer to his family's monastery in Turkey, where Ömer names Rhino as the kidnapper and says Rhino has killed them both.

files.notes: No wiki page; Calypso names him on screen ('The man you are looking for is called Omer Ozdemir. His family owns an old monastery in Turkey'). Wikipedia: a Turkish assassin hired by Aleksei; a one-job hire, so Independent rather than Rhino's Crew. His fate at the monastery is not clear from the sources (he says 'He has killed us both' and Kraven survives the ambush), so status Missing; Deceased is likely.

add.k: An FBI agent hunting the vampire killer
st: FBI Agent Stroud takes the case of the drained bodies on the ship and questions the survivor, Martine, with his partner Rodriguez.
Stroud thanks Michael for the blood that saved his arm, then arrests him after a nurse at Horizon Labs is found drained.
After Michael escapes, Stroud has Martine watched, and CCTV of the new killings shows him the killer is not Michael.

files.notes: Only 'Agent Stroud' is said on screen; 'Simon' appears only in caption speaker labels and the credits, so n is 'Agent Stroud' (app style, like 'Agent Cleary'). FBI said on screen ('FBI Agent Stroud'). Side neither: a lawman pursuing Michael, filed as Compound. Wikipedia says he and Rodriguez release the footage to the media; the transcript only has a news report citing a source, so left out.

st: Rodriguez clears the room on the ship for his partner Stroud, then helps question Martine about the drained bodies.
Rodriguez helps arrest Michael after a nurse is found drained, and presses him over the murder of Nurse Sutton.
Checking CCTV of new killings with Stroud, Rodriguez decides these bloodsuckers multiply.

files.notes: Only 'Agent Rodriguez' is said on screen ('Agents Stroud and Rodriguez'); 'Alberto' and 'Al' come from the credits and Wikipedia, so n is 'Agent Rodriguez'. Filed as Compound like Stroud.

st: At Horizon Labs, Kristen helps Michael and Martine put young Anna into a coma when her fever spikes.
Alone in the hospital at night, Kristen is attacked and drained of blood, and Michael is arrested for her murder.

files.notes: Named on screen after her death: Rodriguez says 'Nurse Sutton, single mother with twin girls' and Michael says 'Her name was Kristen. We worked together every single day for seven years.' That the nurse in the Anna scene is Kristen comes from her wiki page listing Anna as her patient; the subtitles only say 'NURSE'. Michael later tells Martine Milo killed her (in the tie).

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Joe and Mike are the Toro brothers, Cubans who run gambling on the Gulf Coast and launder their cash through Howard Saint. They come to Saint's house together when Castle destroys a shipment of their money.

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Howard Saint washes the Toro brothers' dirty money. Joe and Mike come to his house after Castle destroys their cash, and when a second shipment is burned, Howard refuses to cover the losses.
stages.whoA: The mobster who launders his family's cash
stages.whoB: One of the Toro brothers, his Cuban partners

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Howard Saint washes the Toro brothers' dirty money through his banks. When Castle torches a shipment, Mike warns Howard he could lose everything, and Howard answers that he has more guns.
stages.whoA: The mobster who launders his cash
stages.whoB: His Cuban partner, who warns him over the lost cash

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Frank points out Candelaria at the reunion as the man locals call a witch doctor. After the massacre Candelaria finds Frank dying, takes care of him, and sends him off with 'Vaya con Dios'. Frank answers that God is going to sit this one out.
stages.whoA: The man he nursed back to health
stages.whoB: The local who saved his life

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Maria is Frank's wife, who has followed him through years of moves for his FBI work. At the reunion she tells him they are not lucky but blessed. Saint's men kill her and their son Will, and her memory drives Frank's war on the Saints.
stages.whoB: His wife, murdered by Saint's men

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: Maria and her son Will join Frank's parents and relatives at the first family reunion in five years. Saint's men kill them all and leave Frank for dead.
stages.whoA: Her family, killed with her in Puerto Rico

stages.title: The Punisher (2004)
stages.text: John Saint leads the attack on the Castle reunion. Maria flees with Will, but John runs them both down on the pier.
stages.whoA: The man who kills her and her son

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Sergei sees a scarred man with a Turkish accent among the men who take Dmitri. Calypso gets him the name Omer Ozdemir, and Kraven tracks him to his family's monastery in Turkey, where Ömer names Rhino and the ambush closes in.
stages.whoA: The hunter who tracks him to Turkey

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Ömer is among the four men who break into Dmitri's London apartment and carry him off for Rhino.

stages.title: Kraven the Hunter
stages.text: Rhino is the man behind Dmitri's kidnapping, carried out by Ömer and his men. When Kraven corners him at the monastery, Ömer names Rhino and says Rhino has killed them both.
stages.whoB: The mercenary who took Dmitri for him

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud and Rodriguez are FBI partners on the drained bodies case. They question Martine and Michael together, arrest Michael, and find on CCTV that the killer is someone else.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud thanks Michael for the artificial blood that saved his arm in Afghanistan, then presses him about experiments on a boat. After a nurse is found drained, he arrests Michael, who later escapes.
stages.whoA: The doctor he suspects and arrests

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Stroud questions Martine in the hospital as the only survivor of the ship. After Michael escapes, he orders her watched, but she slips away.
stages.whoB: The FBI agent investigating the ship

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Rodriguez helps question Michael and takes him into custody after a nurse is found drained. In the interrogation he presses Michael over Nurse Sutton, a single mother.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Rodriguez and Stroud question Martine in the hospital about the fang marks on the bodies from the ship.
stages.whoB: An FBI agent investigating the ship

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Kristen works with Michael every day for seven years at Horizon Labs and helps him care for Anna. When she is found drained, Michael fears he killed her and is arrested, then learns Milo did it.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Kristen and Martine work together at Horizon Labs and treat Anna when her fever spikes.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Milo secretly takes the cure and kills Kristen in the hospital at night. Michael is blamed until he realizes Milo is the killer.

changes.was: With his brother Mike, Joe comes to Howard Saint's house over a torched shipment of their cash, and Howard refuses to pay.

changes.why: Two Toro meetings: at Howard's house (after the cash 'rains' down) Howard guarantees their money; he refuses to cover losses only at a later meeting about the shipment torched at Malaqui.
